images.seen: East Asia: Later Jin holds Inner Mongolia and Manchuria, Khalkha holds Outer Mongolia, Tumed gone, Joseon hatched as occupied, small Ming Liaoxi pocket kept; matches the pages. Cliopatria shows one 'Golden Horde' blob over Mongolia, the compiled map is better.

Europe: Lorraine occupied by France, Palatinate and Netherlands contests, Swedish Pomerania and occupations plausible; HRE minor states splintered as intended. Denmark-Norway colour (#cceaff) is nearly the sea colour (#dee9f3).

Brazil: Portuguese coastal strip, Dutch Brazil and a few Spanish-Empire cells in Pernambuco (43 cells, minor); Jesuit Reducciones still carried a Guayra/Itatin block north of the Parana (wrong, patched).
Iraq: north-western Iraq (Mosul, Kirkuk, Erbil) is grey 'nobody' in the compiled map although the pages give it to the Safavids; Cliopatria draws it Ottoman. Patched.
After the patch the Safavid shape holds north-western Iraq; no grey hole.
After the patch Wadai is the Maba heartland west of Darfur; the 606-cell snap and its overlaps with Bagirmi, Bilala and Darfur are gone; Bornu, Bagirmi (vassal tint), Bilala disc, Mandara look right.

issues.what: Jesuit Reducciones keyframe _1629 (the dossier means 1629-1631 only) runs to 1639 in shapes.csv and the compiler unions overlapping keyframes, so Guayra and Itatin (Parana 657 + Mato Grosso do Sul 120 cells) were repainted at 1632 over the ledger loss and the 1632 keyframe and stayed to 1639.

Wadai Empire: keyframe _1636 (the dossier text says 'applied for 1804-1889') starts in 1636 by shapes.csv and unions the whole 280,000 km2 outline over the 1635 heartland keyframe: +606 cells in Batha, Guera and Salamat, with conflicts against Bagirmi, Bilala and Darfur.

Safavid keyframe _1636 removed Kandahar (123 cells) two years early although its own text says 'as drawn for 1636-1637' and ledger/50 removes it in 1638; the Mughal gain of 1638 then took nobody's land.

North-western Iraq (Mosul, Kirkuk, Erbil, 297 cells): the Ottoman ledger loses it in 1625 but no Safavid event or shape holds it, so it was grey 1630-1635 and then Ottoman from 1636, while the pages have the Persians holding 'most of Iraq, including the cities of Kirkuk and Mosul' until Murad IV retook Baghdad in 1638. Now Safavid 1630-1638 (the 1638 Ottoman gain takes it back).

Outer Mongolia is grey (nobody) from the start of the window to 1635: khalkha-khanates begins in 1636 although the Khalkha houses (Tusheet, Zasagt, Setsen) are older; the Khalkha page gives no dates for Outer Mongolia before 1634.
Later Jin / Qing, Khalkha, Tumed, Chahar sequence 1632-1637 (Later Jin 2826-cell snap in 1636, contest with the Mongol Khanate 1632-1635, Joseon occupation 1636-37) read against the image.
Tumed versus Ming in northern Shanxi (133 cell-years, 1632): the Tumed's 200 km disc round Hohhot reaches Datong; the conflict runs since 1547 and the Ming takes the cells back by its 1636 keyframe.
Tsardom of Russia 1636 snap (+2973 cells in Sakha, Irkutsk, Krasnoyarsk): the dossier itself says no page dates a step in 1636 (Cliopatria's interpolation).
Kanem region (Bilala loss of 1630) is grey until Bornu's 1636 keyframe takes it back; follows the Bilala page and is documented in both dossiers.
Dutch Brazil 1637 keyframe keeps only Cliopatria's Ceara piece (181 Ceara cells removed from the ledger gain): a deliberate dossier choice, the page gives no extent.

Size-rule conflicts of 100+ cell-years (Ming/Tumed, Kandy/Spanish Empire, Ethiopia/Fazughli, Kanem/Mandara, Circassia/Nogai) all went to the smaller, locally right state; no conflict reaches 300 cell-years.
Safavid keyframe _1636 releases about 70 cells of the 100 km disc round Yerevan (Igdir, West Azarbaijan) that ledger/49 gives the Safavids but Cliopatria's shape lacks; they end as nobody or Ottoman.

Skipped events: yarubid-dynasty 1633 (Julfar), kutai-kingdom 1635 and kutai-martadipura 1635 (Kutai Lama, Muara Kaman) do not resolve; netherlands-antilles 1636 resolves to no land. The two pages opened for them (Omani-Portuguese conflicts, Muara Kaman) carry neither the event nor coordinates, so no patch event was written.

problems: compiler: do_keyframe unions every keyframe of a dossier that covers the year, and a keyframe without from/to takes its span from shapes.csv. A dossier keyframe written as 'for 1629-1631 only' or 'applied for 1804-1889' without from/to therefore keeps painting its whole Cliopatria shape. Patched here: jesuit-reducciones_1629, wadai-empire_1636. Seen but not patched (no effect inside this window): principality-of-guria_1612 under _1615 (all of Adjara returns 1615-1726; p1610-p1619 sees it), saadi-sultanate_1629 under _1631, iberian-union_1636 under _1637 (Picardy band and Breda claimed again in 1637-1639, lost by size to France and the Dutch Republic), dutch-republic_1636 under _1637 (Venlo and Roermond back). A validator warning for overlapping keyframes whose text says 'only' would find the rest in other windows.

boundary: keyframe_overrides/1 (wadai-empire_1636) gives from 1804 and to 1889, so it starts that keyframe in window p1800-p1809 (shape and text unchanged, only the span). keyframe_overrides/0 (jesuit-reducciones_1629) restates a keyframe that starts in p1620-p1629 with to 1631; shape unchanged.

boundary: the grey north-western Iraq starts in 1626 (the Safavid 1626 keyframe 'ok' holds no Mosul and the Ottoman ledger loss of 1625 has no Safavid mirror), so p1620-p1629 sees the same hole for 1626-1629; my events/0 and keyframe_overrides/2 cover 1630-1638 only (Safavid keyframe _1626 runs to 1635 and unions with nothing new before 1630).

gazetteer: 'Julfar', 'Kutai Lama' and 'Muara Kaman' are not names. The kutai-kingdom keyframes (1300-1634, 1635-1647) and kutai-martadipura_399 (399-1634) use them, so both Kutai states may be absent from the map for their whole lives, besides the 3 skipped 1633/1635 events. Julfar is the area of Ras al Khaymah (the gazetteer has place 'Ras al Khaymah', 55.94 25.79); coordinates for the two Kutai places were not on the pages opened.
